name: NUSEX Collaboration
notes: Groups on the 1985 ICRC paper (OCR): INFN Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati; University of Milan and INFN Milan; Istituto di Cosmogeofisica del CNR and Istituto di Fisica Generale, Turin; CERN. No official roster or institution count was found.

summary.plain: The Italian and CERN physicists from Frascati, Milan, Turin and CERN who built and ran the NUSEX detector in the Mont Blanc tunnel.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the NUSEX nucleon-stability experiment (INFN Frascati, Milan, CNR Turin, CERN).
